- Use a fast minimax with alpha-beta pruning (depth 3) and simple move ordering by a shallow evaluation to pick promising moves first.
- Heuristic evaluation combines:
  - Number of connected components (we want 1) and size of largest connected component.
  - Mobility (number of legal moves).
  - Piece difference (captures matter).
  - Distance-to-center (encourages centralization).
  - Large win/lose bonuses when a side has all pieces connected.
- Always falls back to a legal move if search fails to produce one.

This aims to connect pieces quickly while limiting opponent connectivity and mobility.
